name: Swiftgear Station
summary: Swiftgear Station is a modest farmstead tucked away in the northwest reaches of the Wetlands, nestled in the misty expanse of Sundown Marsh. Marked by a solitary windmill and a dwarven lodge, it serves as a lonely pocket of domestic quiet amidst the swamp's predatory beasts. The homestead is maintained by the gnome Fradd Swiftgear and his companion Wenna Silkbeard.

sections.title: A Lonely Homestead in the Mire
sections.body: Situated within Sundown Marsh, Swiftgear Station stands as a quiet outpost of civilization in an otherwise sodden and perilous region. Unlike the bustling dwarf fortifications at Menethil Harbor or Greenwarden's Grove, this plot consists simply of a dwarven-style lodge and a functional windmill. The homestead is maintained by the gnome engineer and trader Fradd Swiftgear alongside Wenna Silkbeard, who eke out a living amidst the bog beasts, crocolisks, and treacherous mudflats of the northern Wetlands.

aliases: how to get to swiftgear station
faq.answer: Swiftgear Station is located in the northwestern portion of the Wetlands, right along the edge of Sundown Marsh. It can be found north of the main road that leads west toward Menethil Harbor.
The farmstead is inhabited by the gnome Fradd Swiftgear and his companion Wenna Silkbeard, who dwell in and around the dwarven building on the plot.

faq.q: Why is there a lone windmill in the marsh?
aliases: why is there a farm in wetlands
faq.answer: The farmstead and its windmill represent an isolated effort to establish working ground in the marshy lowlands. Despite the waterlogged soil and roaming wildlife, the settlers harness the swamp winds to power their homestead.

faq.q: Is Swiftgear Station a full Alliance settlement?
faq.answer: No. Unlike Menethil Harbor, it is not an armed fortress or commercial port. It is simply a tiny, rustic outpost composed of a single dwarf-style dwelling and a windmill.

angles.text: Seeing Fradd Swiftgear maintaining a homestead and windmill deep in the damp marshes of Khaz Modan is a testament to gnomish grit and independence.
For travelers traversing the dangerous Sundown Marsh, the sight of a friendly lodge and windmill provides a rare and welcoming glimpse of safety.
